count_provenance: The dedicated Trainer resolves sampler.get() once in the parent for this attempt, validates a Sized positive realized partition (including declared count agreement), and passes that same realized sampler to actual worker training. The current parent count is bound before spawn; a worker sidecar cannot replace it. Direct train_model binds the current actual sampler too. Backing dataset length, redrawing partitions and another worker count copy are not the authority.
rejection: Worker/result count must match the independently bound current partition count as well as configured/previous server counts. A failed handoff restores known parent model/dispatch state, retains no accepted result and refuses outbound eligibility; retry with the same current dispatch is valid.
checkpoint_coherence: Existing version1 complete bundles require a valid positive native integer count for each nonzero full-population history. Validation completes before live model/history/config/round/count or pending RNG mutation. Missing counts for zero histories remain possible; this bounded correction does not add a generalized participation ledger or claim detection of deleted counts whose histories are all zero.
callback_coherence: Receive and aggregation guards use existing recursive type-sensitive same_state comparisons of all observed count keys and values, including inactive entries. bool/int, float/int, NumPy integer/native integer and float/integer key equivalences are rejected before accepted commit and roll back known owned state. Postcommit evaluation boundary is unchanged.
